conclusion: All 120 scored attempts and the separate preflight have supported terminal dispositions. findings.finding: The recorded selector implementation freeze did not precede scored launch. The exact written advancement rule was frozen at 10:28:56 UTC, but scoring-tool-manifest.json was recorded at 10:41:28 UTC after 15 scored role spawns and 13 joins: U001-U004 complete plus U005/Z. The preflight final launch verdict asked for the exact selection implementation to be frozen before scored generation.
findings.consequence: Cannot certify a pre-generation implementation freeze or independently verify the manifest assertion that the implementer had not inspected scored answers. The immutable written rule, unchanged code and exact reproduction of the selected result support rule-consistent selection; no evidence of outcome-dependent change was found. This is a historical design-control deviation, not an unexecuted attempt or missing assessment.
findings.remedy: Explicitly disclose this sequencing in current synthesis. Distinguish the pre-generation written-rule freeze from the later code hash. Preserve all historical timestamps and bytes; in future runs freeze and check the implementation before launching scored roles. Do not retroactively claim the stronger gate passed.
